known_issues: PCV breather hose splits on its hidden underside - top cause of P0171/P0174 both-bank lean codes; revised hose exists
Brake booster vacuum line cracks at the mid-run check-valve bulge (cheap hose fix, lean codes)
IMT valve internal O-rings harden and leak - lean codes and rough idle
MAF contamination under-reports airflow so trims worsen with load - clean with electronics cleaner before replacing
Plastic thermostat housing and gasket weep at the 3-bolt flange where the lower hose bends upward; water pumps fade near 100k miles
Lower radiator hose wire clip can pop off and dump all coolant in minutes (TSB jubilee-clip mod, poor access)
Jatco JF506E automatic: clutch piston fractures inside the drum (~1750 GBP specialist rebuild); ATF level needs a temperature-governed procedure, never cold-and-guess
AWD transfer case/PTU has no drain plug or accessible filler and fails without periodic oil service
Outer CV reluctor rings corrode and break, killing ABS wheel-speed signals (~330 GBP per corner at dealer rates)
Crank damper pulley assembly can separate around its rubber bond - front rumble/wobble means replace it
Sill and A-pillar corrosion on early builds: keep drains clear and cavity-wax inject before perforation starts
Spark plugs due around 70k miles and require upper intake removal - renew manifold O-rings/gaskets at the same time
